notes: Converts the official release cargo-dist shell installer; preserves archive selection, extraction, binary installation and embedded checksum verification.
The official install-directory override selects the ordinary-user prefix and INSTALLER_NO_MODIFY_PATH disables profile editing. Other upstream installation metadata is preserved.
Original installer is fetched from the pinned official release URL during build rather than vendored. Every resource is pinned; the target still requires the listed extraction tools.
Selects the official GitHub release through the upstream INSTALLER_DOWNLOAD_URL override; pins the same release archives instead of the default axo artifact host.

Functional check serves a local HTML site on loopback with external networking disabled. Python 3 is a verification prerequisite for the loopback HTTP assertion; not required to install or run oranda itself.
